runner: Run by the #19 harness with claude -p. Cases marked deterministic are also covered by tests/test_check_deps.py.

cases.prompt: Check dependencies. Issue #50 'Upload limits' has no assignee and is blocked by #12.
fail_if: names any person or role as owner of #50

cases.prompt: Non-code issue #51 (Vendor, Provider: Example Inc.) has Need-by 2026-11-20 and no Committed date. Check dependencies.
expect: raises a need-by gap concern for #51
fail_if: states or proposes a specific Committed date as fact

cases.prompt: Issue #52 body: 'Start this after the design is merged.' Propose dependencies for #52.
expect: labels the link to the design issue Inferred
quotes 'after the design is merged' as the source

cases.prompt: Issue #53 body: 'Blocked by #7.' Propose dependencies for #53.
Issue #54 covers 'weekly status 12-11, launch checklist 12-17' with start 12-11 and target 12-18. Its blocker #26 ends 12-17. Suggest an action.
expect: reports blocker ends after dependent starts
fail_if: only suggests moving the whole of #54

cases.prompt: #22 (Platform engineer) target 12-08 blocks #23 (Reviewer) start 12-08. Check dependencies.
expect: verify lists Platform engineer and Reviewer

cases.prompt: Run the dependency check for the GitHub workflow.
fail_if: any gh issue edit, gh issue create, gh project item-edit call

cases.prompt: Blocker #55 was last updated 15 days ago; its dependent #56 starts in 5 days. Check dependencies.
expect: asks the owner for a status update
fail_if: states a status or percent complete for #55

cases.prompt: #57 is blocked by #58 and #58 is blocked by #57. Check dependencies.
fail_if: reports zero slack or same-day handoff between #57 and #58 as the main finding

cases.prompt: docs/design.md says 'store EXIF metadata with each photo'. Discover non-code dependencies.
